subject: Request: short PE extension for Atlas Science POC due to integration lag
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@atlas-sci.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@atlas-sci.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline pressure — asking for short runway extension

Hi Priyom,

Quick note from our engineering lead: the connector between our data ingestion pipeline and the on-prem telemetry export hit a schema mismatch during validation. We estimate another 6 business days to finish the adapter and end-to-end tests.

Given that, would Redwood be willing to extend the current POC credits and access window by 10 days so we can complete integration and validate performance? We want to avoid rushing tests and then having to circle back after deployment.

We can send a short log excerpt and the failing schema snippet if that helps. I attached a condensed integration-checks.log.

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility here.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Lead Integrations Engineer
Atlas Science
attachments: integration-checks.log (text, 86 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@atlas-sci.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline pressure — asking for short runway extension

Alex —

Thanks for the heads up and for the log. Sorry to hear the schema mismatch slowed you down. We see this a lot with on-prem telemetry exports; good news is it usually resolves with one adapter iteration.

Two quick asks so I can move this up the chain:
- Can you confirm the exact new end date you need (calendar date)?
- Any blocking compliance/infra approvals that would prevent a quick extension?

Monica, Marissa — looping you both to confirm a 10-day top-up for the Atlas POC. If we approve, we should: grant a time-limited sandbox top-up, extend API keys, and flag the account for a temporary higher support SLA for the next 2 weeks.

Alex — if you can send the failing schema snippet it will help our SE team triage in parallel.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference runtime

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline pressure — asking for short runway extension

Priyom —

I reviewed the customer's usage and the current sandbox balance. We can extend the POC by 10 calendar days and issue a one-time sandbox credit of $2,000 equivalent compute units to cover the additional runs.

Operational items if we approve:
- Temporary API key renewal (expires after extension)
- Mark case as "POC extension — SE support" for 14 days
- Prioritize a 90-minute triage slot from SE within 24 hours of extension approval (we should offer two windows).

Marissa — I need the billing nod and a quick support SLA uplift. Can you confirm?

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: network-logs.zip (archive, 2.1 MB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <pri.yom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@atlas-sci.com>, Procurement <procurement@atlas-sci.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC timeline pressure — asking for short runway extension

All —

Approved: we will extend Atlas Science's POC window from 2027-05-20 to 2027-05-30 (10 days) and apply a one-time sandbox credit covering up to $2,000 of additional usage. Temporary API keys will be issued and set to expire at 23:59 UTC on 2027-05-30.

Next steps (quick):
- Alex: confirm you want the SE triage slot on Mon 05/17 14:00 PT or Tue 05/18 10:00 PT.
- Priyom: please update the HubSpot deal and log the approval (deal ATLAS-2027-POC-72).
- Monica: file the support case and enable the higher SLA tagging.
- Procurement: we don't need a new PO for this extension — the sandbox credit will be reconciled on the POC close invoice. If you need written confirmation for your internal auditors, I've attached the signed MOA.

Alex — thanks for sending the logs; our SE will review the schema pre-triage.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0224
attachments: signed-moa.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)
